title: Lesson 6: Number Splitting
learningGoals: Split hard expressions into easy mental chunks.
Use splitting across all four operations.
Keep solution flow from left to right.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Open Number Splitting with one fast mental-math hook and connect it to prior knowledge.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Recall what you already know about Addition by Splitting.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Explain the rule behind Addition by Splitting in simple language.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Repeat the rule for Subtraction by Splitting in your own words.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Model Subtraction by Splitting step by step on the board.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Watch the example and say the next step before it is revealed.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Guide the learner through Subtraction by Splitting with prompt-based support.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Solve a scaffolded example on Division by Splitting.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Shift to independent practice on Multiplication by Splitting across difficulty levels.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Answer independent questions on Left-to-Right Simplification.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Diagnose errors and reteach the exact step that broke down.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Explain the mistake and correct it.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Ask the learner to explain the shortcut before advancing.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Summarize the method for Subtraction by Splitting.
